description: Write a new PDF containing only the listed pages, in the listed order. Use it to pull out a range, reorder pages ("3,1,2") or drop pages (list the ones to keep). Pages are 1-based; ranges like "1-3, 7" and reversed ranges like "5-1" work.

output.description: Where to write the result. Defaults to a new file beside the input. Existing files are never overwritten; a free name like file-1.pdf is used instead.

pages.description: Pages to keep, for example "1-3, 7" or "3,1,2".

password.description: Password for a PDF that asks for one when opened. Used only on this machine.

name: extract_pdf_pages
title: Extract, reorder or delete PDF pages
